extracted.name: Artichoke Chicken
extracted.description: Simple oven-baked artichoke chicken is moist and flavorful from the combination of mayonnaise and Parmesan cheese, which creates a rich, golden crust.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Spray a baking dish with cooking spray.
Mix together artichoke hearts, Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, and garlic pepper in a medium bowl.
Place chicken in the prepared baking dish. Cover evenly with artichoke mixture.

Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven until browned in places, chicken is no longer pink in the center, and juices run clear, about 30 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
